description.p: Gitpulsar helps you work with Git repositories through a clean, visual interface. Open a folder with multiple projects and switch between them from the sidebar, or focus on a single repository.

Stage and unstage files with drag-and-drop, review syntax-highlighted diffs, and commit with conventional commit prefixes. Partial staging lets you pick individual hunks or even specific lines within a file.

The integrated branch graph shows your project topology at a glance. Blame view annotates every line with its author and commit. When merge conflicts arise, a three-panel editor helps you resolve them visually.

ul.li: Syntax-highlighted diffs with dark and light theme support
Drag-and-drop staging with hunk and line-level control
Undo and redo for staging operations and discards
Branch graph, blame view, and conflict resolution editor
Keyboard navigation and adaptive layout for all screen sizes

description.p: Improved Flathub metadata: rewritten app description, pinned screenshot URLs to version tag, updated branding colors and keywords.
Redesigned app icon to fit GNOME HIG safe zone. Updated screenshots to 1000x700 for Flathub quality guidelines.

Mobile-adaptive layout with three-tier responsive breakpoints. Added blame view, integrated graph tab, inline commit diffs, and custom GNOME icons. Slide animations for expanding panels. Bundled git CLI in Flatpak sandbox.
Fixed unpushed commit indicators and sidebar not updating after push, pull, or fetch.
Three-way conflict resolution editor, line-level staging, conventional commit prefixes, keyboard navigation, and theme-aware diff colors.
Syntax-highlighted diffs, split staged and unstaged lists with drag-and-drop, partial hunk staging, undo and redo, paginated commits, parallel workspace scanning, and performance optimizations.
Initial release with commit browsing, staging, branches, tags, stash, remote operations, and adaptive layout.
